typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	EndDate as timestamp (),
	ExportFile as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	FileDateStamp as string (),
	HealthVineFile as string (),
	HealthVineFileName as string (),
	HistoryID as integer (),
	PFKFile as string (),
	PFKFileName as string (),
	StartDate as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		REPORT_DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT REPORT_DATA FROM EXTRACT.OH_MSP_EXTRACT_STG WHERE VENDOR_NAME = \'HealthVine\' ORDER BY ORDERNUM',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		REPORT_DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		REPORT_DATA)) ~> FlatFileDestination
